No existing issue found.
summary: Thirteen function test cases expect values their own inputs do not give. `variance` and `std_dev` (eleven cases): the sample variance of -5, -3, -1, 1, 3, 5 is 70 / 5 = 14, the cases say 15.166666666666666; the sample variance of 0, 25, 50, 75, 100 is 1562.5 and the population variance 1250, the cases say 1681.25 and 1345.0; the sample variance of 1.1 … 5.5 is 3.025, the cases say 3.03; the `std_dev` cases are the square roots of the same wrong values. `multiply(-13::i8, -10::i8) [overflow:SATURATE]` is 130, which saturates to 127, and the case says -128. `shift_left(301989888::i64, 8::i32)` is 0x12000000 << 8 = 77309411328, and the case says 19791209299968, a shift by 16.
repro: [variance.test L19-L20, L44, L52-L53](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/blob/b5aeda418813f657011bb82dd1300f996525c3ae/tests/cases/arithmetic/variance.test#L19-L53), [std_dev.test L19-L20, L44-L45, L52-L53](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/blob/b5aeda418813f657011bb82dd1300f996525c3ae/tests/cases/arithmetic/std_dev.test#L19-L53), [multiply.test L16](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/blob/b5aeda418813f657011bb82dd1300f996525c3ae/tests/cases/arithmetic/multiply.test#L16), [shift_left.test L8](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/blob/b5aeda418813f657011bb82dd1300f996525c3ae/tests/cases/arithmetic/shift_left.test#L8). DuckDB 2.0.0: `SELECT var_samp(x), var_pop(x) FROM (VALUES (0.0), (100.0), (50.0), (25.0), (75.0)) t(x)` gives `(1562.5, 1250.0)`; `SELECT var_samp(x) FROM (VALUES (-5.0), (-3.0), (-1.0), (1.0), (3.0), (5.0)) t(x)` gives `14.0`. sverify's model gives the same.
handling: The cases are triaged `case` in `upstream/substrait-cases.json`: they count as disagreements, and the replay fails only on a disagreement the ledger does not list.
